about: Edmonton is Alberta’s capital, on the North Saskatchewan River in the centre of the province. It is a government, university, and energy-services city with one of North America’s largest urban river-valley park systems. Development stretches north–south along the river and includes a large industrial corridor. About 1 million people live in the city.
seoSummary: Alberta’s capital on the North Saskatchewan, known for its river-valley parks.
